error[ZBX-E0903]: a signature record in the store is damaged or newer
  while  reading the signatures of a tree
  cause  /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/trust/signatures/0123456789abcdef is
         damaged: a line of it is not a signed statement
  path   /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/trust/signatures/0123456789abcdef
  fix    remove it, then sign again:   rm /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/trust/signatures/0123456789abcdef
  more   zbx explain E0903
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0903.html
